prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Predictions were generally overly optimistic, especially for major changes, redesigns, and new screens.
Reordering sign-in (sign_in, reorder) was helpful in 2 winning tests, though one specific placement hurt.
Adding a new finish screen (finish, new_screen) hurt performance or showed no clear effect across 2 tests.
Sign-in copy tweaks (sign_in, copy), new adoption flows (adoption, new_flow), and finish hints (finish, hint) showed no clear effect across 2 tests each.
Home wait info changes (home, wait_info) yielded mixed results across 3 tests, with only 1 win.
Evidence remains thin for all other change kinds (redesigns, incentives, layouts, home hints) due to single tests.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, new_flow: +0.7% after noise correction, 2 test(s)
- adoption, redesign: -1.7% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- adoption, wait_info: +2.2% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- choose_path, copy: -4.7% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- choose_path, incentive: -2.1% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- choose_path, layout: +2.5% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- finish, hint: -0.0% after noise correction, 2 test(s)
- finish, incentive: +2.1% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- finish, new_screen: -4.5% after noise correction, 2 test(s)
- home, hint: +0.1% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- home, redesign: -3.0% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)

- sign_in, reorder: +0.7% after noise correction, 3 test(s)

Changes:
0: [choose_path, new_screen] Companion Persona Quiz Screen: Insert a short interactive quiz screen right before choose_path to guide users toward preset vs custom pet creation. (why: choose_path dropoff is 23.9% (76.1% conversion) with a mean time of 514s, showing users get stuck deciding how to create their pet.)
1: [adoption, redesign] Pick Friend Compact Card Layout: Redesign the pick_friend screen with a compact card layout and rounded companion selection elements. (why: Adoption conversion is the lowest in early setup at 60.9%, taking median 89s and mean 1017s. A compact card structure makes comparing pet options faster.)
2: [finish, new_flow] Interactive Desktop Pet Drop Preview Flow: Rebuild the home_intro screen with an interactive pet preview component allowing users to drag and test their pet avatar. (why: Finish conversion drops to 64.8%, and 3 support emails specifically reported confusion around how to control or view their pet on the desktop.)
3: [home, wait_info] Waiting Screen Mascot Animation and Audio: Add an animated mascot and subtle chime audio cue to the waiting screen during pet creation. (why: The waiting step takes median 201s and mean 2336s. Engaging audio-visual feedback prevents users from assuming the app has frozen.)
4: [sign_in, copy] Account Cloud Backup Assurance Copy: Reframe the sign_in headline and body copy around protecting pet progress and cloud backup. (why: Top support theme (8 emails) was pets missing or resetting after signing in again. Clear reassurance upfront builds confidence in signing in.)
5: [choose_path, layout] Choose Path Centered Layout Refresh: Switch the choose_path screen layout to centered framing to focus user attention on the two primary creation paths. (why: 23.9% of users abandon at choose_path. Centered focus reduces clutter and encourages immediate action.)
6: [adoption, incentive] Adoption Certificate Mascot Stamp Highlight: Add a visual certified companion badge and mascot animation to the adoption certificate screen. (why: Adoption has a heavy dropoff (60.9% conversion). Adding a playful confirmation badge creates an emotional reward moment.)
7: [home, notification] Background Generation Completion Sound Notification: Enable background audio completion chime when pet generation finishes on the waiting screen. (why: Mean time spent on home/waiting screen is 2336s, indicating users tab away. A completion chime alerts them when their pet is ready.)
8: [finish, hint] Home Intro Desktop Controls Hint Banner: Display a hint banner on the home_intro screen explaining how to access right-click companion settings. (why: Finish step conversion is 64.8% and multiple support tickets mention confusion over how to control, hide, or interact with the pet once onboarded.)
